route_a.label: assumption-driven (prior predictive)
route_a.claim: conditional only: IF a pathogen had these properties, THEN its outbreak would look like this

route_b.label: pooling-driven (posterior predictive for a new arm)
route_b.claim: GIVEN the measured human outbreaks, a fourth unmeasured one would plausibly fall in this range
route_b.caveat: this describes the population of human pathogens the measured arms are drawn from, NOT this specific hypothetical pathogen
